name: gizza-ai/create-zip
summary: Bundle multiple files into a ZIP archive.

tool.description: Bundle multiple files into a single downloadable ZIP archive (deflate-compressed). Provide at least one file; each is a URL or a `ref` to an uploaded attachment. Entry names come from each file's name; duplicate names are made unique.

files.description: Ordered list of files to bundle. Each item has exactly one of `url` or `ref`. Entry names come from each file's name; duplicates are made unique.

url.description: URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
